scope: Extend the legacy compound INSERT transaction matrix to cover DXF MINSERT array counts and spacing with attached attributes.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_Insert generated by the transaction harness
source.profile: One 2-column by 3-row MINSERT with column spacing 4.5, row spacing 5.5, two attached ATTRIB records, and the existing companion classic POLYLINE chain.

implementation.method: Extend the existing legacy compound whole-file sweep; at each allocation failure require destination rollback and unchanged parent/child callers, then retry with the same codec and compare clean bytes plus fresh typed readback of MINSERT classification, array counts, spacing and both attributes.

validation.verboseCTest: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_legacy_compound_entities_allocation_transaction$': PASS; all 14 version/encoding calibrations report rollback/retry/readback PASS

limitations: Generated serializer/parser transaction evidence only; consumer array expansion, producer interoperability and native MINSERT semantics are not qualified.
Only one 2x3 attributed-array profile is covered; alternate dimensions, spacing and attribute combinations remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The generated attributed MINSERT array preserves counts and spacing across seven DXF revisions and both encodings through all measured failure offsets, same-codec retry and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer and compound-record inventory; retain producer and native consumer qualification gates.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 195 completed slices and 35 remaining packages: 195/(195+35)=84.8%; count-based, not effort-weighted.
